supplemental.oracle: Pinned GGML CPU objects from the imported portable oracle with contraction disabled.
supplemental.views: Run all eight shapes on ordinary and transposed one-word offset views with half-pixel or aligned corners, each with two input distributions.
supplemental.input: For backing index i use (((13*i+11)%41)-20)/2^(i%6). In the exceptional distribution replace i%37=0 with negative infinity, otherwise i%31=0 with negative zero, otherwise i%29=0 with a quiet NaN.
supplemental.broadcast: Four inputs [3,1,(1<<k)+14,1] for k in {31,40,49,56} use zero depth stride and source words [0x80000000,0x40400000,0x3f200000]. The output shape is [7,2,5,1].
supplemental.refusals: Surplus source and invalid flag words 255, 514 and 770 refuse admission and execution and preserve all output bytes.
supplemental.interpolation: GGML antialiased bilinear interpolation with clamped source windows, ordered binary32 triangle weights and normalization.
